senses.sense_definition: The exhibition or depositing of a ship's papers at the customhouse.

examples.text: The captain completed the <w>entry</w> of the vessel at the port.

examples.text: Customs <w>entry</w> must be filed within 24 hours of arrival.

target_lang_translations.ru: Таможенная <w>декларация</w> должна быть подана в течение 24 часов после прибытия.
